correctness.rationale: Proof reconstructs the full flag from the Gauss tangent subspace by polynomial gcd and saturated quadratic ideal; equivariant stabilizer proves scheme isomorphism. The explicit rank-(2n+1) bundle quotient computes Plücker character a=(2n+1)(d−2),b=n. Weyl dimension and standard highest-weight orbit normality give complete Hilbert function. Leading coefficient and independent projective-bundle Segre pushforward give the same closed degree. A 42-case rational checker independently tests the arithmetic, not the infinite proof. Domain is all complex n≥2,d≥3.

value.rationale: The natural Plücker degree and complete graded coordinate dimensions of the Gauss image form a canonical enumerative problem, not an arbitrary finite slice. The result gives exact homogeneous geometry for every degree and dimension in a natural singular family and clarifies a different invariant from higher Gauss maps on the smooth Veronese. The flag realization/polarization can support additional projective equations and intersection calculations.
